title: End of the world?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are people fascinated by predictions about the end of the world?
Do frightening global scenarios make people prepare better, or simply make them anxious?
Which global risk do you think people underestimate most?
How can people stay informed about serious threats without becoming obsessed with them?
If scientists announced a very low-probability global threat, how should governments communicate it?
